capabilities: Builds multi-dashboard home screens with draggable cards
Searches files, tags, properties and commands
Embeds notes, tasks, calendars, web pages and plugin views
Connects to community plugins and external feeds
Reflows dashboards into a mobile column
extras: README points to a separate Hearth User Guide for full reference; the plugin was created using AI; Plugin view is beta and focus-taking is experimental.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in start page or dashboard for searching, launching notes and viewing live vault information in one place.

relations.evidence: Becomes the engine behind the search bar
Tasks cards read one-note-per-task vaults — status, due date and priority from frontmatter
Tasks cards read and write its board notes in its own format
The Dataview card: DQL and DataviewJS, rendered live
The Git card, acting through the plugin's own task queue
Four cards on Operon's Developer API
The Periodic note card: this week's, month's, quarter's or year's note
Drawings render live in Embed cards
The Vault Pet card gives the plugin a place on the board
Issues from a saved Jira filter or JQL search

summary: Customizable Obsidian home screen with fuzzy search, live dashboard cards, launchers and plugin integrations.
